description: Authorization is skipped for every operation on shared, namespace-less pipelines, including writes.

provenance.construction: reverse of 186dd1f3b0: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 3 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: The check returns success whenever the namespace is empty, so any authenticated user can delete or modify global pipelines. The fix kept the skip for get and list but authorized writes against the system namespace; that authorization is deleted here. GitHub rated the advisory high.

issues.description: canAccessPipeline returns nil for all verbs when the namespace is empty, so create, update and delete on shared pipelines are never authorized.
